planets.name: WASP-99 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-99 with a 5.75-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-99 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-99. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
